scope: Every documented Device Service HTTP operation; positive functionality and rejection-only coverage are distinct.
validation_category: virtual-device and live HTTP; hardware NOT RUN

positive_phase_plans.visible-preview: Create visible Preview; poll ready; run immutable checkpoint twice in the same PID; validate application READY, input, cancel/recovery, Run-bound frame, renew, ZIP-before-close and retained history.
positive_phase_plans.checkpoint-store: Store exact complete checkpoint; retry bytes under alternate encoding; verify immutable ID, metadata, full file bytes and error cases.
positive_phase_plans.visible-session: Exercise this operation only on an owned visible guest; bind outputs to firmware/PID/execution and capture evidence ZIP before stop purge=0.
positive_phase_plans.catalog-and-health: Read actual configured service metadata; distinguish supported, backend-ready, host admission and current runtime capabilities.
positive_phase_plans.isolated-control-plane: Use a separately bound service/state directory; exercise worker HMAC, job lease fencing, retention, and drain/resume without affecting shared sessions.
positive_phase_plans.artifact-upload: Upload exact bytes, retry and read metadata; test chunk resume/hash mismatch and delete only the artifact allocated by this sweep.
positive_phase_plans.firmware-intake: Compose uploaded/source firmware with exact source and normalized flash hashes, then execute it through visible Device Service sessions.
